title: ARCH↔PO-001: Product Requirements + Feasibility Feedback
description: Product Owner/TPM provides prioritized feature requests with business/field context, target timelines, and constraints; the Architect returns feasibility assessments, technical trade-off options (cost/risk/timeline), and early warning of architectural constraints affecting scope. The Architect's feasibility assessment is authoritative input, not a negotiable opinion. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.1 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.1.

architectural_constraints.description: Early warning of constraints affecting scope.

adr_required.description: True if a decision requires a formal ADR (e.g., platform/protocol/budget).

scope_lock.description: Mandatory consultation before locking any release scope with architectural dependencies.

architect_consulted.description: Must be true before scope_locked = true.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Scope/feasibility decisions with architectural dependencies require ARB-level deliberation; the Architect's feasibility verdict is authoritative (governance note §6.1). Feature intake without architectural impact is Tier-3.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (weekly sync during planning; ad hoc feasibility review during backlog grooming); mandatory consultation before locking release scope with architectural dependencies
confirm_conditions: feasibility_assessment has a verdict; FEASIBLE_WITH_TRADEOFFS includes ≥ 1 tradeoff_option with cost/risk
adr_required = true is honored (ADR filed) before scope is locked
scope_lock.scope_locked = true only when architect_consulted = true
reject_conditions: scope_locked = true without architect_consulted (violates §6.1 governance note)
verdict = INFEASIBLE overridden by PO without an ADR (Architect verdict is authoritative)
adr_required = true but scope locked with no ADR
counter_conditions: FEASIBLE_WITH_TRADEOFFS but PO needs a single recommendation — request the Architect's preferred option
timeline target conflicts with every tradeoff option — request re-prioritization or timeline relaxation
